Defence Minister Launches First Fleet Support Ship for Indian Navy

Defence Minister Rajnath Singh launched the first Fleet Support Ship (FSS-1) for the Indian Navy at Hindustan Shipyard Limited (HSL) in Visakhapatnam. The event also included the laying of the keel for the fifth Fleet Support Ship (FSS-5), the inauguration of an upgraded slipway, and the opening of a 300-tonne crane at the shipyard. All three events occurred on the same morning.
